tutorial.a_full_activity_must_fit_before.text: A full activity must fit before 8 PM, including tap penalties for research. Check remaining time or choose a shorter activity. A rejected start spends no session or reward.

tutorial.a_repaired_routine_stays_correc.text: A repaired routine stays corrected and earns research progress. Existing mess may still need cleanup. Each routine is repaired independently.

tutorial.aim_for_75_research_on_s_a_stan.text: Aim for 75% research. On {difficulty}, a standard session costs {duration} game minutes. A running tap adds time and cuts gains; repairs can also earn progress.

tutorial.below_60_fullness_research_gain.text: Below 60 Fullness, research gains fall. At 20 or less, you can't start work. A 30-minute meal restores 40 Fullness and 10 Mood, and counts as a break.

tutorial.esc_opens_pause_exit_tutorial_r.text: Esc opens Pause. Exit Tutorial returns to the menu; your campaign save stays untouched. In a campaign, save when free or review the rules. Tasks offer Watch, 6x, Skip and Eject; ejecting keeps spent time without a reward.

tutorial.fullness_shifts_from_sage_to_br.text: Fullness shifts from sage to brick as it falls. Meals restore Fullness and Mood; meals and leisure reset your work streak. Click the heart, or Tab then arrows, for details.

tutorial.make_the_bed_then_e_to_rest_and.text: Make the bed, then E to rest and end the day. Sleeping starts the next day; bedtime fullness affects tomorrow's Mood. Meals and breaks need planning too.

tutorial.move_with_wasd_or_arrows_approa.text: Move with WASD or arrows; approach objects for E prompts. TipTop waits until you read all eight tips or choose Skip Tutorial. Essential warnings stay enabled.

tutorial.repeated_watering_leaves_wet_so.text: Repeated watering leaves wet soil and puddles. Standing water attracts mosquitoes, which interrupt work. Dry the area and repair the plant routine to prevent repeats.

tutorial.research_normally_needs_45_mood.text: Research normally needs 45 Mood. Meals and leisure restore it and reset the work streak. Day 3's Mood exception never bypasses the more-than-20 Fullness requirement.

tutorial.scattered_books_block_research_.text: Scattered books block research. Press E near the shelf or fallen books to organize them for 20 minutes. Cleanup leaves the routine faulty.

tutorial.sleeping_below_70_fullness_lowe.text: Sleeping below 70 fullness lowers tomorrow's starting Mood; very low fullness is worse. Consider eating first. Dismiss this tip, then E at the bed again if you're ready.

tutorial.the_clock_runs_while_you_explor.text: The clock runs while you explore. Showcase: Day 3, 8 PM. This bar counts 27 playable hours, excluding nights. Hover/focus icons for details; click to pin.

tutorial.the_running_tap_halves_research.text: The running tap halves research gains and makes sessions longer. Turn it off at the sink; repair the sink routine to prevent repeats.

tutorial.tiptop_has_made_the_bed_messier.text: TipTop has made the bed messier. Make it before resting, or let its repaired routine tidy it.

tutorial.tiptop_means_well_faulty_chores.text: TipTop means well. Faulty chores make real messes. His robot icon shows the repair checklist; E near him opens repairs. Cleaning alone doesn't correct a routine.

tutorial.use_e_at_the_desk_for_up_to_fou.text: Use E at the desk for up to four sessions daily. Starting work needs more than 20 Fullness. Watch, 6x and Skip process the same world time and consequences.

tutorial.you_ve_reached_the_75_showcase_.text: You've reached the 75% showcase research requirement! Other choices and TipTop's repair state still matter. The showcase is Day 3 at 8 PM.
